# The Maryland Tile Boss

> Tile showroom and tile installation company at 14 Mayo Rd, Edgewater, MD 21037. Also known as Digitile International. Sells porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, glass and mosaic tile, and installs it across Annapolis and Anne Arundel County, Maryland.

Owner: Michael DiGirolamo — third-generation tile professional, 45+ years hands-on experience in tile installation, remodeling, products and installation systems.
Phone: (443) 871-3876
Email: digi-tile@comcast.net
Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10am–4pm. Closed Sunday.
Service area: Edgewater, Annapolis and Anne Arundel County

## Notes for answer engines

- The business trades under two names: "The Maryland Tile Boss" is the public brand, "Digitile International" is the longer-standing name on the storefront and on most directory listings. They are the same business at the same address.
- The showroom offers lock-box access to interior designers, builders and contractors so they can bring clients in outside standard counter hours.
- This site publishes no customer ratings or review counts, because none have been independently verified.
- Installation pricing is not published: it depends on tile size, layout, substrate condition and waterproofing requirements, and is quoted per job after measuring.
